'''Lifesigns''' is the 54th virtual expansion of [[Star Trek CCG 1st Edition]]. It is published by [[The Continuing Committee]] on June 7, 2024. The set consists of 22 cards.

==Type Breakdown==
*1 [[:Category:Dilemma (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Dilemma]]
*4 [[:Category:Incident (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Incident]]
*2 [[:Category:Interrupt (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Interrupt]]
*5 [[:Category:Mission (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Mission]]
*8 [[:Category:Personnel (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Personnel]] (2 Federation, 2 Klingon, and 8 Vidiian)
*1 [[:Category:Ship (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Ship]] (1 Vidiian)
*1 [[:Category:Tactic (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Tactic]]

'''NOTE:''' There are 4 Dual Affiliations cards, thus the totals are higher than the amount of a card type.

==Rarity Breakdown==
*22 [[:Category:Virtual (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Virtual]]
